verdict.rationale: NetHunt says MCP-compatible assistants like ChatGPT and Claude can connect to the CRM, and a probe found an OpenAPI spec, so an agent pathway exists. Native automations can also adjust pipeline stages on trigger events. Nothing shows that the MCP or API can write deal stages or next steps, or that an agent can act on email or meeting signals. missing for 10: documented MCP/API write operations for deal stage and next-step fields, agent access to email and meeting signals, an end-to-end example of agent-driven pipeline updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to NetHunt in a few clicks.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
